sequences.name: Premium Wildlife Safari Early Access
sequences.goal: Drive early-access bookings and replies from Premium Adventurers interested in wildlife safari across the 90-day window.
sequences.rationale: Wildlife safari interest is up 37% YoY with a breakout rising query and 61.5% affinity in this segment; an early access offer fits an aspirational tone and a Tuesday 07:00 modal send, staying within the 2/week fatigue cap.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Early access: small-group safari season is open
emails.preheader: Members see wildlife departures before anyone else.
emails.creativeDirection: Full-bleed wide shot of an African savanna at golden hour; single headline overlay; one CTA button 'See early departures'; minimal layout, no price callouts.
emails.rationale: Rising 'small group safari' query and 61.5% affinity support leading with early access.

emails.subject: Small-group safari: what the early window includes
emails.preheader: A closer look at small-group wildlife itineraries.
emails.creativeDirection: Editorial layout: 3-image strip of wildlife, short itinerary bullet list, aspirational copy with a guide photo; CTA 'Explore the itinerary'.
emails.rationale: Content story builds consideration among members with strong safari and eco-lodge affinity.

emails.subject: Plan your safari before the holiday rush
emails.preheader: Early access window still open for wildlife departures.
emails.creativeDirection: Calm split layout: left a sunrise safari photo, right a checklist of planning steps; CTA 'Hold your early spot'.
emails.rationale: Giving Tuesday and holiday demand boost (1.1-1.2) make a planning-focused early access nudge timely.

emails.subject: A safari story to bookmark for your next trip
emails.preheader: Field notes from a small-group wildlife journey.
emails.creativeDirection: Long-form story email: one hero photo, traveler quote as pull-out, no hard sell; CTA 'Read the field notes'.
emails.rationale: Mid-window story maintains engagement without a hard sell, supported by a segment click rate of 8.9%.

emails.subject: Make this the year you go on safari
emails.preheader: Early access for members planning their next adventure.
emails.creativeDirection: Bold resolution-themed hero with sunrise over savanna, large numeric '2027' type; CTA 'Start planning my safari'.
emails.rationale: New Year resolution week (demand boost 1.5) is the strongest demand window in the plan.

emails.subject: Last call for early safari access this season
emails.preheader: Early access closes soon for wildlife departures.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean closing layout: safari photo header, countdown-style text block, single CTA; weekend-themed imagery for MLK weekend.
emails.rationale: MLK weekend (demand boost 1.3) and the window end (2027-01-30) support a closing early access reminder.

sequences.name: Premium Adventurers snow sports early access program
sequences.goal: Drive early-access bookings for snow sports trips among Premium Adventurers during the Nov 2026 to Jan 2027 window.
sequences.rationale: Snow sports interest is up 12% YoY with a breakout snowshoe lodge query, and 54% of eligible segment members show affinity. Early access fits the aspirational tone and the Alps launch on 2026-11-20. Sends stay on the segment's Tuesday 07:00 modal slot and use at most one email per week, well under the cap of 2.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Early access: Alps Ski Week opens to you first
emails.preheader: Your preview window for Alps Ski Week starts before public launch.
emails.creativeDirection: Full-bleed alpine dawn photo with a single-column layout; hero headline overlaid in white; countdown block showing time until public launch on 2026-11-20; one primary button.
emails.rationale: Launch is 2026-11-20 and snow sports affinity is high in this segment; early access fits the aspirational tone.

emails.subject: Alps Ski Week is open. Your early access ends soon
emails.preheader: Snow sports departures are filling. Secure your place this week.
emails.creativeDirection: Split layout: left panel carousel of three ski-day photos, right panel itinerary highlights; a slim banner reading early access closes Sunday; one button.
emails.rationale: Follow-up in launch week reinforces the early-access window with the segment's strong click behavior.

emails.subject: Why snowshoeing is winter's most rewarding trip
emails.preheader: A look at how snow sports travel is evolving, from lodge stays to backcountry trails.
emails.creativeDirection: Editorial story layout: long-form hero image of a snowshoe trail, pull-quote, then three inline thumbnails linking to snow sports trips; no hard sell.
emails.rationale: Rising snowshoe lodge search interest supports an editorial story that builds desire ahead of the winter peak.

emails.subject: Snowshoe lodge packages are trending this season
emails.preheader: See which lodge packages travelers are searching for right now.
emails.creativeDirection: Grid of four lodge package cards with season-specific imagery and short descriptors; a rising-search callout badge; minimal text.
emails.rationale: The breakout 'snowshoe lodge package' query and seasonality index of 1.55 justify a mid-winter early access push.

emails.subject: Plan your winter escape before the window closes
emails.preheader: Snow sports dates in the winter window are limited. Look ahead.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean hero with a winter lodge exterior; a short bulleted list of remaining snow sports options; secondary text link for the full calendar.
emails.rationale: Mid-January is the late-window push, matching the segment's engagement and seasonality.

emails.subject: Last call for early access snow sports trips
emails.preheader: Early access for snow sports closes at the end of January.
emails.creativeDirection: Bold closing layout: dark alpine background, single headline, a clear end-of-window date block, and one button.
emails.rationale: Final reminder before the plan window closes on 2027-01-30, reinforcing early access urgency.

sequences.name: Cycling for Mindful Explorers – 90-Day Content Story Series
sequences.goal: Build cycling and bikepacking interest among Mindful Explorers through educational content, driving clicks to cycling trip pages.
sequences.rationale: Cycling search interest is up 54% YoY with a breakout rising query, and Mindful Explorers show strong cycling affinity and a 6.8% mean click rate, so an educational content story fits this steady, value-driven segment across the full window.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Why gravel bikepacking is having a moment
emails.preheader: Slow travel by bike: what's drawing explorers to gravel routes this season.
emails.creativeDirection: Hero photo of a loaded gravel bike on a quiet country road at golden hour; single-column layout, short intro paragraph, three-bullet 'what to know' list, one text link.
emails.rationale: Opens the series with the breakout trend (54% YoY interest) to match the educational tone.

emails.subject: Riding routes that honor the open road
emails.preheader: A Veterans Day read on self-guided cycling routes, planned at your own pace.
emails.creativeDirection: Muted, calm illustration of a cyclist crossing a bridge with a route map overlay; two-column layout pairing a route sketch with a short story; no hard-sell visuals.
emails.rationale: Holiday-adjacent educational story; Veterans Day falls at plan start +9 days, and the send stays within the segment's two-per-week cap.

emails.subject: Cycling in the cold: a winter riding guide
emails.preheader: Layering, route choice, and daylight planning for winter cycling trips.
emails.creativeDirection: Warm-toned photo of riders on a snowy trail with a layering checklist graphic; single column, numbered list of tips, soft white space.
emails.rationale: Winter guide keeps the story going through the low-seasonality months (index 0.48) without a sales push.

emails.subject: A four-week cycling fitness plan for new riders
emails.preheader: Build endurance gradually with a simple, educational training progression.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean infographic-style layout showing a four-week progression as a stepped bar chart; minimal copy, single CTA button.
emails.rationale: New-year resolution week is a high-interest moment (demand boost 1.5); a structured educational plan suits the segment's value-driven tone.

emails.subject: Eco-lodges and the rides between them
emails.preheader: How multi-day cycling routes connect low-impact lodging and local landscapes.
emails.creativeDirection: Full-width landscape photo of a lodge nestled among hills with a cyclist in foreground; short narrative block and a map thumbnail.
emails.rationale: Pairs cycling with eco-lodge interest (50% share among segment top interests), keeping the message educational and sending Monday 08:00 after MLK weekend.

emails.subject: Your cycling reading list, updated for winter
emails.preheader: A curated recap of this season's cycling guides, with what to read next.
emails.creativeDirection: Card-based layout with four linked article thumbnails in a 2x2 grid; short recap line at top; no discount or urgency language.
emails.rationale: Closing recap consolidates the series and gives readers a low-pressure next step before the window ends.

sequences.name: Family Winter Camping Bundle Sequence
sequences.goal: Convert Family Getaways members with camping affinity into winter camping bundle bookings across the 90-day window.
sequences.rationale: Winter camping search interest is up 26.5% YoY with a breakout in heated tent camping, and 58% of eligible Family Getaways members show camping affinity; a bundle offer fits the segment across the full window.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 40 segment members (8%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Winter camping is heating up for family trips
emails.preheader: Cozy, comfortable, and built for the whole crew this season.
emails.creativeDirection: Hero image of a family around a lantern beside a heated tent at dusk; playful headline overlay; single bundle card below with three icons (tent, sleeping bags, campfire kit).
emails.rationale: Camping affinity and rising 'heated tent camping' queries support a playful introduction to the bundle.

emails.subject: Pack the gear before the holiday travel rush
emails.preheader: A family camping bundle ready to book before Thanksgiving.
emails.creativeDirection: Split layout: left panel shows a packing checklist illustration, right panel a family unpacking a camp kitchen; bold bundle CTA button centered.
emails.rationale: Thanksgiving demand boost (1.2) makes a pre-holiday planning nudge timely for camping-affine families.

emails.subject: A winter adventure bundle for the whole family
emails.preheader: Pair camping with a family week for a stress-free holiday break.
emails.creativeDirection: Warm, playful collage of snow-covered campsite and family laughing by fire; bundle breakdown in three short bullets; soft gift-style ribbon accent.
emails.rationale: Following the Yellowstone Winter Family Week launch, a camping-plus-family bundle extends interest in winter family trips.

emails.subject: Resolve to get the whole family outdoors in 2027
emails.preheader: New year, new campsite plans. Bundle options for families.
emails.creativeDirection: Clean, upbeat layout with a sunrise over a campsite hero; resolution-style headline; three-step bundle explainer with icons.
emails.rationale: New Year resolution week (demand boost 1.5) aligns with a family outdoor-goal framing.

emails.subject: Last call: family camping bundles this winter
emails.preheader: Book a family camping bundle before the season wraps up.
emails.creativeDirection: Bold closing-season layout: campfire photo with countdown-style text block; compact bundle summary; clear single CTA.
emails.rationale: Seasonality index of 1.09 across the window supports a closing reminder as the plan ends.

sequences.name: Cycling for Deal Seekers: Winter Booking Promo
sequences.goal: Drive bookings on cycling trips during the low-season window by pairing promo framing with rising gravel-bike interest, peaking around Black Friday / Cyber Monday and New Year resolution week.
sequences.rationale: Cycling affinity is 53.8% among 26 eligible Deal Seekers with a 54% year-over-year search lift, but seasonality is low (0.48), so emails are spaced to avoid fatigue while concentrating volume around high-boost promo holidays.
sequences.suppressionNote: 3 of 30 segment members (10%) excluded for sensitive life events; used for suppression only

emails.subject: Gravel bike tours are breaking out. Here's the plan
emails.preheader: Search for bikepacking is up 54% year over year. See what's worth booking now.
emails.creativeDirection: Hero image of a gravel rider on a dirt road at golden hour; clean two-column layout with a short route-highlights list and a single bold CTA button.
emails.rationale: Leads with the 54% YoY bikepacking lift and breakout 'gravel bike tour' query to give a no-nonsense, fact-led hook for a deal-minded audience.

emails.subject: Cycling trips with the Black Friday deal in view
emails.preheader: Early access to our best-value cycling departures before the holiday sale.
emails.creativeDirection: Split layout: left, a bold 'Early Access' badge; right, a price-comparison-style card grid of three cycling trips; minimal copy, high contrast.
emails.rationale: Gives Deal Seekers first look ahead of Black Friday (1.8x demand boost), using the 53.8% cycling affinity to target the right trips.

emails.subject: Black Friday: our cycling promo is live
emails.preheader: Promo pricing on cycling trips. Book before the sale window closes.
emails.creativeDirection: Bold promo banner in brand color with a countdown-style 'Sale ends' line; product grid of cycling trips with the promo tag on each card.
emails.rationale: Black Friday carries the highest demand boost (1.8x) and this segment's mean click rate is 7.9%, supporting a direct promo send.

emails.subject: Last call on cycling promo. Plan your winter ride
emails.preheader: Promo pricing ends soon. Lock in your gravel or road cycling trip.
emails.creativeDirection: Simple text-forward layout with one hero cycling photo, a short bulleted list of promo trip highlights, and a clear 'Book now' button.
emails.rationale: Covers Cyber Monday and Giving Tuesday follow-through with a 'last call' angle to convert promo-responsive members.

emails.subject: New year, new ride: cycling trips for 2027
emails.preheader: Resolution week picks: book a cycling trip while the new-year offer lasts.
emails.creativeDirection: Bright, energetic hero shot of riders on a winter-to-spring route; checklist-style layout titled 'Your 2027 ride plan' with a single CTA.
emails.rationale: New Year resolution week (1.5x demand boost) is a strong planning moment; a bundle framing fits a value-seeking segment and closes the window ahead of plan end.
